_comment: Integrity lockfile for the on-device NER RUNTIME (WEBEXT-01 F-1/F-2 fix, gate #13 / §1.6). scripts/vendor-ner-runtime.ts copies each artifact from the EXACT npm-pinned package in node_modules at build time (npm run prebuild), verifies SHA-256 + byte length against this manifest, refuses any ESM artifact containing bare/off-origin module specifiers (the F-1 dead-on-arrival class that shipped inside transformers.web.min.js), and exits non-zero on any mismatch (fail-closed BUILD). The bundle (public/vendor/transformers.bundle.min.js — the package's SELF-CONTAINED dist/transformers.min.js browser build, onnxruntime inlined) is COMMITTED; the ort WASM artifacts (public/vendor/ort/) are git-ignored and re-vendored each build, served same-origin under CSP 'self' with env.backends.onnx.wasm.wasmPaths pinned to '/vendor/ort/' in src/lib/nerPiiDetector.ts BEFORE any session creation (F-2: unset wasmPaths defaults to a jsdelivr CDN URL the deployed CSP blocks). transformersJsVersion MUST equal TRANSFORMERS_JS_VERSION in src/lib/nerPiiDetector.ts and ner-weights.lock.json transformersJsVersion; onnxruntimeWebVersion MUST equal the exact onnxruntime-web version @huggingface/transformers pins — both enforced by scripts/vendor-ner-runtime.test.ts + scripts/vendor-transformers-version.test.ts. To bump: update the package.json pin, run `npx tsx scripts/vendor-ner-runtime.ts --update-lock`, review the diff, re-run the WEBEXT-01 browser-real probe harness (real in-browser load + inference under the deployed CSP), and re-soak.
